reasoning: On the season so far the Raptors are the stronger team; with home court the Raptors start about 9 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Raptors.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Raptors win 77 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 199 and 248 total points.
